out.page: Export Export the records of one Desk module as a file you can download again for 7 days, and see the exports made so far. New export One module at a time. Choose a saved view, the fields and a date range if you want less than everything; the file holds the records you can see. Module Choose a module File format CSV (.csv) Records All records A saved view exports the records its criteria match, in its order. Fields All fields Leave empty to include every exportable field. Date field This module has no date field Date range Any time Protect with a T_ Wraps the file in a ZIP encrypted with AES-256. The T_ is needed to open it, is not stored and cannot be recovered. The file downloads now and stays available in the history for 7 days. You'll also get a notification and an email when it is ready. Up to 50,000 records per .csv file.
